title: Feb 2026 Product Innovation
label: TIKTOK SHOP · PARTNER GUIDE
subtitle: Updated 2026-03-18
html:
Below are this month’s new Seller Center features and updates. These are designed to help your agency drive stronger campaign performance, improve operational efficiency, and scale seller growth more effectively.

TikTok Shop Campaigns

🛍️ Buy More Save More (BMSM) + Buy X Get Y (BXGY)

📌 What it is: BMSM and BXGY promotions are now unified into a single setup flow in Seller Center. Sellers can easily configure bulk discounts (e.g., spend more, save more) or bundle offers (e.g., buy one, get one) from one streamlined interface. 💡 Why it matters for agencies:

  • Makes it easier to launch and test different discount strategies
  • Drives higher AOV through bundling and upsell mechanics
  • Reduces setup friction when managing multiple promotions
  • Enables more flexible campaign planning across SKUs

⏩ Agency action: Recommend BMSM for increasing basket size, use BXGY for inventory clearing or bundle strategies, and incorporate into campaign and promo calendars 🧠 Learn more in this Feature Guide.

Seller Growth

📈 Growth Benefits Center

📌 What it is: Sellers can now replace unavailable product links without deleting or reposting their videos. 💡 Why it matters for agencies:

  • Prevents loss of GMV when products go out of stock or are delisted
  • Keeps high-performing content active
  • Reduces creator downtime or manual content fixes

⏩ Agency action: Encourage sellers to check their relink alerts daily and replace unavailable SKUs immediately. 🧠 Learn more in this Feature Guide.

🎥 Video Assistant: AI-Powered Content Creation

📌 What it is: A new centralized hub that shows sellers their current growth tier, benefits, and recommended actions to scale. It connects with Growth Opportunities to provide a full view of how to increase GMV and unlock rewards. 💡 Why it matters for agencies:

  • Gives a clear framework for seller growth planning
  • Helps prioritize highest-impact actions
  • Makes performance gaps and next steps more visible
  • Aligns seller efforts with TikTok Shop growth incentives

⏩ Agency action: Use this as a baseline for seller strategy conversations, align monthly goals to tier progression and recommended actions, and track progress and adjust plans based on insights.

🔁 Product Subscriptions – Modify Discount

📌 What it is: Sellers can now reduce subscription discount rates for future subscribers while maintaining the original discount for existing subscribers. 💡 Why it matters for agencies:

  • Provides more control over margins
  • Enables seasonal or promotional pricing adjustments
  • Protects existing subscriber relationships
  • Supports long-term subscription strategy

⏩ Agency action: Review subscription pricing strategies with sellers, adjust discounts based on seasonality or performance, and balance growth vs. profitability. 🧠 Learn more in this Feature Guide.

Shoppable Video

🎥 Shoppable Video Content Management Upgrade

📌 What it is: An upgraded content management hub in Seller Center that allows sellers to view, filter, and take action on all shoppable videos. Replaces the previous “Manage Content” page with improved tools. 💡 Why it matters for agencies:

  • Makes it easier to monitor content performance at scale
  • Speeds up identification of high- and low-performing videos
  • Improves workflow for optimizing and promoting content
  • Reduces manual tracking across multiple videos

⏩ Agency action: Use this to audit seller content regularly, identify videos to boost, iterate, or replace, and build content optimization workflows around this dashboard.

🎬 Shoppable Video Creation Entry Upgrade

📌 What it is: An improved entry point for creating shoppable videos within Seller Center, designed to make content creation more accessible and intuitive. 💡 Why it matters for agencies:

  • Reduces friction for sellers starting content creation
  • Encourages more consistent posting
  • Supports scaling content output across accounts

⏩ Agency action: Encourage sellers to adopt this new flow, use it in onboarding for new sellers or content teams, and pair it with content planning and posting cadence.

Partner Apps

🧰 Zendesk for TikTok Shop

📌 What it is: A new integration that centralizes customer support within Zendesk, allowing sellers to manage communication, support tickets, and insights in one place. 💡 Why it matters for agencies:

  • Improves customer experience and response time
  • Centralizes support operations for scaling sellers
  • Provides better visibility into customer issues
  • Reduces operational fragmentation

⏩ Agency action: Recommend for sellers with higher order volume, integrate into customer support workflows, and use insights to identify recurring issues.

📌 TLDR; This month’s updates focus on:

  • Driving higher AOV (BMSM, BXGY)
  • Improving growth visibility and planning (Growth Benefits Center)
  • Scaling content operations (Shoppable Video upgrades)
  • Improving operational efficiency (Zendesk, subscription flexibility)

👉 Focus on helping your sellers optimize promotions, scale content, and align to growth tiers.
